pages.jaRuby:
「……そっか。良かった、つい夢中でやっちまったけど、あれはあれで良かったんだな」
「はい。ですが、今後はあのような行動は控えてください。私は傷を負ってもマスターさえ健在ならすぐに回復できます。ですが貴方が傷を負っては、私には治す術がない」
pages.en:
“…I see. Good. I acted without thinking, but it really did work out.”

“Yes. Nevertheless, you must refrain from such behavior in the future. If I am wounded, I can recover quickly so long as my Master remains well. But if you are wounded, I have no means of healing you.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I see. That’s good. I was desperate, but that was good, huh?”
“Yes. But please refrain from such actions next time. I can heal immediately even if I am wounded. But I have no way to heal you if you are wounded.”

分かった、気をつける。確かにアレは軽率だった。次はもっと巧くやる」
どう巧くやればいいか判らないが、ともかく考え無しで飛び出すのは止めよう、と自分を戒める。
と。

pages.en:
“Right—I understand. I'll be careful. It was reckless. Next time I'll handle it better.”

I have no idea how I might do that. Still, I warn myself not to charge out again without thinking.

Then—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ugh… All right, I’ll watch out. That was definitely reckless. I’ll do better next time.”
I don’t know how I can do things better, but I should stop doing things so recklessly.
Then…

「はい。いい返事です、マスター」
そんな俺の素振りがおかしかったのか。
セイバーは一瞬だけ、笑ってくれたように見えた。
pages.jaRuby:
「はい。いい返事です、マスター」
そんな俺の素振りがおかしかったのか。
セイバーは一瞬だけ、笑ってくれたように見えた。
pages.en:
“Yes. A good answer, Master.”

Perhaps something in my manner strikes her as funny.

For one instant, I think I see Saber smile.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes. That is a good reply, Master.”
Was I acting that funny?
I think she smiled for a second.

pages.en:
“————”

Heat floods my head, and I shake it away.

There is something more important I need to settle.

Something I should have asked her yesterday, after we returned:

whether she truly is the Servant of someone like me,

and whether she truly means to take part in this war.
